scripts.typecheck: bun node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p forge/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.fix: bun run format && bun run lint --fix
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run knip && bun run lint:docs && bun run check:map
scripts.ci:local: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd forge --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run test:coverage && bun x --no-install commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD
